notes: Hand-curated damage sim data. Item base stats come from items.json and skill formulas are parsed from skills.json; this file adds conditions, stacks and procs the text can't express.
Values: % steps use fractions (0.15 = 15%), flat steps use plain numbers. perStack × stacks is added to value; atMax is added at max stacks.
An item or hero listed here replaces its Effects tab entries in the sim.
"reviewed" lists items checked and left out of the sim on purpose, with the reason (the coverage script skips them).

Hero attribute tooltip (in game): STR = 5 HP per point, INT = 5 MP per point, primary attribute = 3 damage per point. AGI (crit chance, attack speed) is ignored. baseHp 6740 is fitted to one reading (L105 Water Mage: 21,890 Max HP with 1,850 STR and 5,900 gear HP).
